scope: loopback nginx + synthetic upstream; not production acceptance
tests_count_unit: unittest methods (subtests are not extra tests)
ttl_semantics: 1s fallback only; origin explicit TTL wins; no instant deletion claim
limitations: No production requests, writes, reloads, credentials, FRP or DB operations
Forwarding/security template requires comparison with actual target vhost
max_size=128m is async eviction target, not a hard quota
Native upstream stale cache extensions require separate review if introduced
